title: campanula dichotoma subsp. kremeri
intro: Campanula dichotoma subsp. kremeri, commonly known as Fructicola or Alpine Harebell, is a subspecies of the Campanula dichotoma plant, belonging to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its antioxidant and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of Campanula dichotoma subsp. kremeri include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
